# Code of Conduct

## Our Standards

All participants in this project are expected to:

- Be respectful and constructive in all communications
- Provide helpful and actionable feedback
- Accept differing viewpoints and experiences
- Focus on what is best for the project

The following behaviors are not acceptable:

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks
- Trolling or deliberately disruptive behavior
- Any form of discrimination

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all project spaces - GitHub Issues, Pull Requests, Discussions, and any other communication related to this project.

## Enforcement

Violations may be reported to **info@samuel-steiner.com**. The project maintainer will review all reports and take appropriate action, including removing comments or banning participants.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
